forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8b80
+title: 'Inkling2MTPIntegrationTests.verifyPassMatchesDecodeSteps: share the stepped-vs-verify helper'
+---
+From the review of ^2r778tc (ab4b94e5), `duplication/duplication` at `Tests/MLXLMTests/Inkling2Tests.swift:706`: "The new tiny-model test repeats the body of the existing integration test `verifyPassMatchesDecodeSteps`: prefill a cache, step each token to build the reference logits, prefill a second cache, run one verify pass, and compare the results. ... Extract the stepped-versus-verify comparison into a helper in a support target that both test targets can import, such as `MLXLMTestSupport` or `IntegrationTestHelpers`. ... Keep the change on the Inkling2Tests side; leave the integration-test counterpart for a separate task."
+
+The unit-test side now calls `verifyDifferenceFromDecodeSteps` (Tests/MLXLMTestSupport/VerifyAgainstDecodeSteps.swift). Remaining: make `IntegrationTesting/IntegrationTestingTests/Inkling2MTPIntegrationTests.swift` `verifyPassMatchesDecodeSteps` use one shared helper. MLXLMTestSupport is not a product, so the IntegrationTesting project cannot link it as is; move the helper to `IntegrationTestHelpers` (which both can depend on) or add the dependency. Run Inkling2MTPIntegrationTests in Release after.
+
+#inkling
